cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Would you sell your signed guitar so we can replace the fridge?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I queued all night for that signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then let's price it properly. Those hours should buy us an ice maker.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sell the case. The guitar stays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the case. You can still tell the queue story while I photograph the guitar.

mechanism: A invokes lessons in valuing things to persuade a pupil to sell a cherished guitar for a shared appliance.
confusable: The pursuit is actual relinquishment of the loved item, not only choosing a price or selling an incidental case.
comparison: Ceremonial surrender for recognition versus keeping a memory while selling the central object.
seedUse: Retain D12 overnight signature story and case counteroffer; S05 financial lesson changes how the attachment is graded.
